messages.content: Bobby made a big batch of soup weighing 80 kg. Each day the batch gets reduced by half. How many kg will it reach on the fourth day after he made the soup?

On the first day, the soup is reduced by half, so it will be 80 kg / 2 = 40 kg. On the second day, it gets reduced by half again, so it will be 40 kg / 2 = 20 kg. On the third day, it gets reduced by half once more, so it will be 20 kg / 2 = 10 kg. On the fourth day, it gets reduced by half again, so it will be 10 kg / 2 = 5 kg.

FINAL: 5
